name.en: Mono PERC, bifacial (passivated emitter and rear cell)
name.es: PERC monocristalino bifacial (emisor y celda posterior pasivados)

description.en: Monocrystalline silicon cell with a passivated rear side (PERC), 60 cells (6x10). Reference: JA Solar JAM60D00 300-320/BP, datasheet title '320W Bifacial Mono PERC'. Replaces the earlier aggregator listing (EnfSolar, no maker).
description.es: Celda de silicio monocristalino con cara posterior pasivada (PERC), 60 celdas (6x10). Referencia: JA Solar JAM60D00 300-320/BP, ficha titulada '320W Bifacial Mono PERC'. Sustituye la ficha anterior de agregador (EnfSolar, sin fabricante).

typical_use: Mid-cost 60-cell mono PERC modules; the reference datasheet is bifacial.

cell.note: Datasheet: 'Cell Quantity 60 (6x10)'. Cell size, busbar count and efficiency not stated.

geometry.description: Framed bifacial mono PERC module 1675 x 998 x 30 mm (JA Solar datasheet). Glass, encapsulant and cell thicknesses: front glass 3.2 mm typical, EVA and cell from Fraunhofer ISE lab-module reference. Rear type not stated (0.35 mm reference). Frame height 30 mm from datasheet, footprint width typical. Junction box placement and size typical.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module long side, y along short side, z up through thickness; origin at module front-left corner; mm. Here z=0 is the front glass face and z grows toward the rear through thickness.

unverified_items: Glass type and thickness not stated (3.2 mm typical). Encapsulant material not stated.
Rear type (backsheet or glass) and rear thickness not stated; 0.35 mm is a reference only, status not_found.
Cell size, busbar count, cell efficiency and module efficiency not stated.
Frame material and footprint width not stated (typical).
Junction box size/placement typical. Cable length not stated.
Encapsulant 0.45 mm and cell layer 0.18 mm are Fraunhofer ISE lab-module references, not product values.
The reference is bifacial; the monofacial PERC values may differ.
